paragraphs: Here's what I want you to carry out of this one, friend. God gave Aaron and his sons the exact words, "This is how you are to bless the Israelites." (Numbers 6:23) And every single line is about what the LORD does: He blesses, He keeps, He shines, He gives peace. (Numbers 6:24-26) Nobody in that blessing is told to go earn it.

Now look at the last verse, because it's the best part. God says, "So they shall put My name on the Israelites, and I will bless them." (Numbers 6:27) The priests speak the words, but the blessing is God's own, and He's the one who says "I will bless them." That's like me stamping a cookie, friend: the stamp is in my hands, but the whole batch is going to the Supper because of the One who sent me.

So when you feel like you have to hold it all together yourself, remember this passage. You don't make your own blessing happen, and you don't have to. I spent years in a dark drawer thinking nobody was looking my way, and then God's light found me, so I know that face shining on you is the real thing. Rest in it, baker, and then go bake.
